title: Foodstamps.ETH
tagline: Food Stamps public goods project built on Ethereum to replace the current legacy system
description:
This project aims to be an Ethereum public goods project to replace the current food stamp system in the US and globally. Currently, in the US there are over 41 million people surviving on Food Stamps. They spend upwards of $1.5 Billion dollars a year. We believe that access to financial services is a human right.   

*https://vitalik.eth.limo/general/2022/10/28/revenue_evil.html
